#Looking for a fun afternoon with friends? A romantic date idea? A family outing? Take a Tandem for a spin!

##About
Tandem bikes are the perfect way to enjoy a bike ride together. These “bicycles built for two” are comfortable, durable, and offer a completely different experience from cycling alone! 

As with all our rentals, Tandems include locks and helmets. Tandems are not recommended for children. Delivery fee is $50 for 24+ hour rentals only. Please call us for more information.
